verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public sentry.io/pricing page, but the quoted content only describes a Free tier for solo devs and plan features such as SAML + SCIM. Nothing shows per-signal rates (errors, spans, logs, replays) or quotas an SRE could use to forecast spend without contacting sales. A plan-feature listing is adjacent to the story, not per-signal pricing transparency.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales
